AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions:
Phocid is a local music player: it indexes every audio file on the device into one library and keeps playback statistics for it.
Operational patterns: - Use searchTracks to resolve a track the user names before acting on it. - Use getNowPlaying to answer what is playing, then setPlayback to change it. - Use getLibraryStats for library-wide counts and getPlaybackStats for listening history.
Constraints: - The library is local only; there are no streams, accounts, or playlists. - setPlayback requires the player to be running and the queue to contain the requested item. - Statistics start when this build began recording; older listening is not available.
